issues.description: Every extraction run requires external story files, so the documented tiny demo fails from this checkout.
Default stories_dir points at data/stories, but the repository contains no story manifest or story files.
The end-to-end tiny integration test currently fails with FileNotFoundError for data/stories/manifest.json.
Validation loads vector artifacts without checking backend, model, layer count, or d_model compatibility.
Preference steering loads vectors and manifest metadata without validating shape or backend compatibility.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still returns one component, so disabling neutral projection is impossible.
dtype='auto' is treated as None, likely loading HuggingFace models in fp32 instead of the intended automatic dtype.
Activity-token steering falls back to steering the entire prompt when offset mapping is unavailable.
Preference scoring assumes ' good' and ' bad' are single-token encodings and silently uses only the first token.
Unknown or sparse emotion sets can produce an empty scenario stack or NaN off-diagonal summary.
Steered emotion selection silently falls back to the first four emotions, weakening the reported validation signal.
Elo computation is order-dependent because pairwise updates are applied sequentially over a fixed pair list.
Dependencies are broad minimum-only ranges with no lock file, making demo and test reproducibility fragile.
Generated demo artifacts are checked in while the source data needed to reproduce them is absent.
